🇪🇺🇺🇦 EU strips drone funding from first Ukraine loan tranche — Euractiv

The first tranche of the EU's €90 billion Ukraine aid package will no longer include €5.9 billion earmarked for drone production. Instead, Kiev will get €3.2 billion in direct budget support.

Euractiv reports the change is officially "technical" — Brussels wants tighter control over how the money is spent. Overall defense funding isn't being cancelled: a significant chunk of the €60 billion package still goes toward Ukraine's defense, with separate packages on ammunition, air defense, and drones to be announced later.

The EU will procure and deliver the drones itself — to avoid corruption on the Ukrainian side.
